articles.summary: Block devices, file systems, and why remote file storage has always been slow. A ground-up look at what a file system actually is, and how Archil makes a shared one fast enough to run git clone on.
articles.title: Understanding file storage

articles.summary: Every cloud workload -- databases, sandboxes, CI, analytics -- is built from the same three parts. Why a single write-ahead log on S3, speaking POSIX, can collapse all of them into one storage system.
articles.title: Building the last WAL on S3

articles.summary: Archil introduces traditional, forkable sandboxes with persistent disk and ability to host network services.
articles.title: Introducing Persistent Sandboxes

articles.summary: Archil is one of the few storage services that actually stores customer data rather than delegating it to S3. Durability math, correlated failure, erasure coding, and copysets -- what it takes to not lose your data.
articles.title: How to store data safely
